description: A splat over an unknown choice of non-empty lists is not equal to an empty list
notes: The spec says a comparison with an unknown operand gives an unknown bool. ConditionalExpr.Value refines the unknown list with the range of its results' lengths, SplatExpr.Value (hclsyntax/expression.go) keeps that range for its result, and Value.Equals (cty/value_ops.go) uses it to rule out an empty list.
